Hi Rachel,

Great to meet you at Re:Connect last week — Concordia's partnerships team is excited about the potential to co-sell an observability + inference stack with Redwood. We put together a short integration checklist (attached) and a draft MoU to get the commercial conversation started.

High-level asks to unblock the first 90 days:
- Quick technical intake (30–45m) with your SE to validate integration scope (service-to-service auth, billing attribution, telemetry hooks).
- A one-page go-to-market brief (who owns which assets / demos).
- Confirmation of what evidence Concordia needs for your cloud marketplace listing (metering, SKU names, technical samples).

I attached our checklist and the MoU draft. Can you point me to the best person on your side to run the technical intake? We prefer next week (Tue/Wed PDT).

Thanks,
Samir Patel

Hi Samir / Rachel,

Thanks — I reviewed the checklist. A couple of technical clarifications before the intake so we use the time well:

1) Auth model: is Concordia proposing token exchange via our service account or direct customer creds for the joint integration? If service-to-service, we need the public JWKS and expected token lifetime.
2) Telemetry: which metrics matter for Concordia co-sell dashboards (inference latency, throughput per SKU, attribution tag)? We can expose a lightweight Prometheus / push gateway hook.
3) Marketplace demo: do you need a hosted demo (Redwood-hosted) or a self-deployable sample (K8s + Helm)? Hosted demo short-circuits onboarding but requires a billing mapping/commit.

Proposed intake agenda (30m):
- 0–5m intro & desired outcomes
- 5–10m auth and security model
- 10–20m telemetry & SKU mapping
- 20–25m demo & lifecycle (who hosts what)
- 25–30m next steps & owners

I can take Tue 21st at 09:30 PDT for 30m. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and a short prep doc.

Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachment stub: technical_intake_prep.md (text)

Marcus / Rachel — thanks for the quick review and proposed agenda. Tue 21st 09:30 PDT works for us.

Answers inline:
- Auth: Concordia prefers service-to-service with short-lived tokens; I'll send our jwks.json and an example token exchange flow before the call.
- Telemetry: primary metrics: infer_latency_p50, infer_latency_p95, tokens_per_request, attributed_customer_id. Attribution should accept a 5-char partner tag in request metadata.
- Demo: hosted demo is preferred initially so field teams can demo without a deploy step; we can discuss billing mapping (Concordia will consume Redwood calls under a partner SKU).

I've uploaded the jwks and a network diagram to the shared Drive (link below) and started a DocuSign for the MoU draft to speed approvals.
